recognize_zh: 剛果紅（Congo red）染色中間質布滿塊狀橘紅色無定形沉積物（長箭頭），並包覆血管，右上方短箭頭指向一群慢性發炎的淋巴漿細胞浸潤；橘紅色無細胞沉積即類澱粉，骨髓瘤病人應考慮 AL 類澱粉沉積症。
features: Nodular and sheet-like salmon-orange congophilic amorphous deposits (long arrow)
Deposits encircle small vessels and separate stromal fibroblasts
Aggregate of small dark lymphoplasmacytic inflammatory cells at upper right (short arrow)
Paucicellular stroma between deposits with occasional small capillaries
describe_en: Congo red-stained section at intermediate power shows abundant nodular salmon-orange amorphous deposits in the interstitium and around vessels (long arrow). A small cluster of lymphocytes and plasma cells is present at the upper right (short arrow). The intervening stroma is paucicellular. Findings are consistent with amyloid deposition; in the setting of multiple myeloma this is most likely AL amyloid, pending confirmation of apple-green birefringence and amyloid typing.

ddx.vs: Hyalinized collagen is Congo red negative or only faintly stained and lacks apple-green birefringence.
LCDD deposits are Congo red negative and show monotypic light chain staining in basement membranes without fibrils.

ddx.dx: Nodular pulmonary AL amyloidoma with MALT lymphoma
ddx.vs: Localized amyloidoma may arise from an extranodal marginal zone lymphoma, which requires evaluation of the associated lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate for clonality.
